issues: Pages 1-44 all portrait but table content printed sideways (landscape orientation); re-rendered with +270 deg rotation to read upright. No ТР ТС section headings present anywhere in the document - only lab-address full-width rows appear as section-like headings (e.g. '410064, Саратовская обл., г.Саратов, ул. им. Блинова Ф.А.,13 А'), which were correctly excluded from tr_section per instructions, so tr_section is null on every row. Several rows list dual/conditional ranges (e.g. pesticide residues 'с концентрированием' vs 'без концентрирования', or госсипол given in both мг/кг and % ); these are kept as full descriptive text in range_from with range_to/unit null rather than arbitrarily picking one interpretation. Item 92/93 (ГОСТ 30483) and 94 (ГОСТ 10854) list sub-clauses without repeating the object/okpd2/tnved columns on later sub-clauses; these were carried forward from the nearest full statement of those columns. Item 16 and item 17 (and similarly 18, 19) each present multiple objects with distinct ranges under a single table row number; one JSON row was emitted per object+indicator combination, reusing the shared norm_doc. Item 118 and 123/124 do not print codes in columns 4/5 for that specific line (shown blank in the source); left null rather than inferring.
